items.title: Hormuz traffic falls to two observed commodity vessel crossings
items.discovery: September 22 global transport and energy scan
items.summary: Preliminary Kpler data showed two commodity vessels crossing the strait on September 21, down from ten the previous day. Reuters also reported separate attacks on a crude tanker and an LPG carrier; both continued without towing. The count excludes vessels sailing with tracking signals off.
items.logisticsImpact: Check vessel position, war-risk terms and routing directly with the carrier before committing Gulf cargo. Observed transit counts are incomplete when ships turn off tracking signals.

items.title: France prepares UN proposal to protect navigation through Hormuz
items.discovery: September 22 global transport and energy scan
items.summary: Diplomats told Reuters that France is working on a UN Security Council resolution for an international mission to safeguard navigation in the Strait of Hormuz. The proposal has not been adopted.
items.logisticsImpact: A diplomatic proposal does not restore normal sailings. Continue to plan on current carrier advisories, insurance conditions and actual vessel movements.

items.title: Higher tanker costs pressure Venezuelan crude trade
items.discovery: September 22 global transport and energy scan
items.summary: Traders are seeking deeper discounts on Venezuelan crude as tanker freight rises. Reuters reported a roughly $3.5 million Aframax charter from Jose to the U.S. Gulf Coast, compared with $1.35 million earlier this year.
items.logisticsImpact: Recheck delivered costs and vessel availability before pricing crude movements; freight volatility can materially change the economics of a shipment.

items.title: Europe faces fourth-quarter jet fuel supply deficit
items.discovery: September 22 global transport and energy scan
items.summary: Europe is expected to face a jet fuel shortfall in the fourth quarter despite more supply arriving from South Korea, Reuters reported, citing Energy Aspects. Longer supply routes and low inventories are adding pressure.
items.logisticsImpact: Air freight buyers should watch fuel surcharges and capacity decisions; the forecast is a supply outlook, not a confirmed flight disruption.

items.title: India adjusts crude sourcing as Russian oil imports decline
items.discovery: September 22 global transport and energy scan
items.summary: India’s Russian crude imports fell in August and preliminary data point to a further September decline, Reuters reported. Refiners have sought more barrels from other origins, including the Middle East.
items.logisticsImpact: Changing origins can shift tanker demand, voyage lengths and terminal requirements. Confirm the actual loading port and routing for each cargo.
